data.one_liner: Access and modify native device calendars and events on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter interface to interact with native device calendars. It allows you to create, retrieve, edit, and delete calendars, events, reminders, and attendees, alongside automatic permission handling.
use_when: You need to read or write calendar events inside a Flutter mobile app.
You want automatic permission handling for accessing device calendars.
You need to create events using native platform UI or ICS format on Android.
avoid_when: You are targeting web or desktop platforms where native calendar APIs are not supported.
You only need local database storage without native calendar sync.
strengths: Automatic permission handling out of the box
Supports both iOS and Android native calendars
Comprehensive management of calendars, events, reminders, and attendees
weaknesses: Event recurrence is currently under development
Limited to mobile platforms (iOS and Android)
data.setup_notes: Requires platform-specific configuration for Android and iOS as detailed in PLATFORM_SETUP.md.
